# Josie Pye

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md) (cousin)

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

A member of the Pye family, Josie is known for her disagreeable nature and sharp tongue, though she possesses a notable skill for knitting lace and a distinct talent for walking board fences. She pursues her college studies purely for the sake of education, as she does not need to earn a living.

## History

Josie Pye grew up in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where her mother was a cousin to [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md). She attended the local school alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and was present among their group of schoolmates when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) took a dare to walk across a roof. Josie later joined Miss Stacy's advanced class to prepare for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. After successfully passing, she moved to town to attend Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) alongside her peers. During their first term, Josie visited Anne's boarding-house room with [Jane](../character/jane.md) and Ruby, where they shared the news about the Avery scholarship to [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).

## Quotes

> “Oh, that reminds me,” said Josie, “Queen’s is to get one of the Avery scholarships after all. The word came today. Frank Stockley told me—his uncle is one of the board of governors, you know. It will be announced in the Academy tomorrow.”
>
> — Josie Pye — [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P24](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0024)

> "If I don’t pass this year I’m coming back next. My father can afford to send me. Anne, Frank Stockley says that Professor Tremaine said Gilbert Blythe was sure to get the medal and that Emily Clay would likely win the Avery scholarship."
>
> — Josie Pye — [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P14](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0014)

## Relationships

### [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-atossa--josie-pye.md)
